summary: Spero Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing FDA approval of Utebzi (tebipenem pivoxil) for complicated urinary tract infections. This is a regulatory milestone and product approval announcement, not a special situation transaction. The filing references GSK's development and licensing agreement but does not report any new deal, tender offer, acquisition, spin-off, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special situation event. It is a routine disclosure of a product approval and prior licensing arrangement. No deal terms or financial transaction details are provided. There is no change of control, tender, or capital structure action.
